ui.handbook.unit06: Unit 06 – s, p and d block elements
ui.handbook.exp01.title: Experiment 1: Demonstrating the properties of cathode rays
ui.handbook.exp01.aim: Identify cathode-ray tube circuit components and observe the properties of cathode rays.
ui.handbook.exp02.title: Experiment 2: Displaying the shapes of molecules and ions using models
ui.handbook.exp02.aim: Understand bonding and the three-dimensional arrangement of atoms in simple molecules and ions.
ui.handbook.exp03.title: Experiment 3: Handling glassware and four beam balance
ui.handbook.exp03.aim: Identify laboratory glassware and its uses, and use a four beam balance for mass measurements.
ui.handbook.exp04.aim: Develop glassware, weighing and volume-measurement skills to prepare solutions of required concentration.
ui.handbook.exp05.title: Experiment 5: Experimental determination of molar volume of a gas
ui.handbook.exp05.aim: Collect and measure gas volumes and calculate the volume of one mole of oxygen under laboratory conditions.
ui.handbook.exp06.title: Experiment 6: Experimental determination of molar mass of magnesium using molar volume of hydrogen gas
ui.handbook.exp06.aim: Develop the skill of determining the relative atomic mass of a metal using gas-volume measurements.
ui.handbook.exp07.title: Experiment 7: Experimental determination of the enthalpy of acid/base neutralization
ui.handbook.exp07.aim: Measure reaction temperature changes and determine the enthalpy of acid–base neutralization experimentally.
ui.handbook.exp08.title: Experiment 8: Validation of Hess law through experiment
ui.handbook.exp08.aim: Compare enthalpy changes along two reaction pathways to investigate Hess law.
ui.handbook.exp09.title: Experiment 9: Comparison of reactions of s block metals with air, water and acids
ui.handbook.exp09.aim: Compare reactions of s block elements and relate observations to periodic trends.
ui.handbook.exp10.title: Experiment 10: Identification of elements in compounds by the flame test (Li, Na, K, Ca, Sr, Ba)
ui.handbook.exp10.aim: Test metal salts and identify metal ions from their flame colours.
ui.handbook.exp11.title: Experiment 11: Identification of anions
ui.handbook.exp11.aim: Identify anions in aqueous solution and carbon dioxide gas, and practise using delivery tubes.
ui.handbook.exp12.title: Experiment 12: Showing the presence of nitrogen in air by experiment
ui.handbook.exp12.aim: Demonstrate the reactions of magnesium with air and the formation of magnesium nitride.
ui.handbook.exp13.title: Experiment 13: Identification of halides
ui.handbook.exp13.aim: Identify chloride, bromide and iodide ions when present separately in solution.
ui.handbook.exp14.title: Experiment 14: Standardization of a solution of thiosulphate ions using KIO₃ and KI
ui.handbook.exp14.aim: Develop the knowledge needed to conduct redox titrations.
ui.handbook.exp15.title: Experiment 15: Identification of ammonia gas and ammonium salts
ui.handbook.exp15.aim: Identify the presence of ammonia gas and ammonium salts.
ui.handbook.exp16.title: Experiment 16: Testing the solubility of salts of s block elements
ui.handbook.exp16.aim: Investigate which salts of s block elements precipitate in water with common anions.
ui.handbook.exp17.title: Experiment 17: Testing the thermal stability of nitrates, carbonates and bicarbonates of s block elements
ui.handbook.exp17.aim: Investigate patterns in the thermal stability of s block nitrates, carbonates and bicarbonates.
ui.handbook.exp18.title: Experiment 18: Identification of the colours of complex ions in aqueous medium
ui.handbook.exp18.aim: Identify the colours of aqueous ions formed by d block elements.
ui.handbook.exp19.title: Experiment 19: Determination of the concentration of a ferrous ion solution using acidified potassium permanganate
ui.handbook.exp19.aim: Prepare a ferrous ion solution and determine its concentration using a self-indicating redox titration.
ui.handbook.exp20.title: Experiment 20: Determination of the concentration of KMnO₄ solution using standard acidified K₂C₂O₄ solution
ui.handbook.exp20.aim: Prepare a primary standard solution and determine the concentration of permanganate ions by redox titration.
